english.note: Use this when the sense is specifically the white piano keys contrasted with the black keys.

examples.english: When playing piano, do not just press the ivory keys with your left hand; play the black keys too.
examples.traditional: 彈琴時，左手唔好淨係按白鍵，要配埋黑鍵。
